description: Tarin reports seeing Sella place an unlabeled paper envelope on the Lantern Harbor registry desk during Bell-7, the sole seventh-watch registry-bell sounding on the seventh day of Embermonth, year 12.

Sella reports she was physically at North Tower throughout that same Bell-7 ringing and was not at Lantern Harbor at any point during it; Bell-7 is the sole seventh-watch registry-bell sounding on the seventh day of Embermonth, year 12.
